description: This file defines the BouncePostDatedCheckHandler class, which implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface to handle commands related to bouncing post-dated checks within the repayment process. It delegates the bounce operation to the RepaymentWithPostDatedChecksWritePlatformService.

classes.name: BouncePostDatedCheckHandler
classes.description: A service class that handles the bouncing of post-dated checks in the repayment process by implementing the NewCommandSourceHandler interface.

methods.name: BouncePostDatedCheckHandler
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the handler with the required repayment service.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes a JsonCommand to bounce post-dated checks by delegating to the repayment service, annotated with @Transactional to handle transaction management.
